mapping.audio_axis: tap cell k <-> taps[k]; mel10 frames 4k..4k+3; neighbours out of range -> zero tokens
mapping.dequant: int8 * scale_l from pca/i8_9-16-24.npz (whiten=False), then per-token LayerNorm (no affine, eps 1e-5)
mapping.fakes: canon events are playable only (fakes are kept separately), as chart_from_canon reads doc["events"]

features.A_tap: cells c-1,c,c+1 x 8 bands x 1024 (dequant + per-token LN) -> per-token PCA 85 dims fitted on train+val songs -> 2040 dims; variance kept per layer: L9 0.660, L16 0.661, L24 0.493
features.A_all: concat of the three A_tap features (6120) -> second-stage PCA 2048 dims (train+val rows), variance kept 0.924
features.A_all_rp: reduction check: fixed Gaussian random projection (seed 12345) of each tap's 3 x 8 x 1024 block to 682 dims, 3 taps concatenated = 2046 dims (no fitting)
features.A_all_rpd: A_all_rp + random projection (seed 54321, 682 dims per tap) of relu(token(c) - token(c-1)), relu(token(c+1) - token(c)) = 4092 dims (token analogue of spectral flux)
features.B: mel10 frames 4c-2 .. 4c+5 (8 x 128 = 1024 dims, raw Pupu-normalised log-mel)
features.B_flux: B + rectified frame differences (7 x 128) + per-frame summed flux (7) = 1927 dims
features.B_heur: non-learned: 10 ms bin b = argmax over b of summed positive flux at frame 4c+b+1, prediction = bin centre 10b+4.5 (expect decoder; argmax gives 10b)
features.D: train marginal of the 40 offsets (chance); D_mode = per-mode marginal
features.E: A_all + rhythm context (40 dims): gaps from the cell start back to the previous 4 distinct onsets of the same chart and the 4 IOIs among the previous 5; each as seconds, log1p(ms), sin/cos of the 40 ms phase, + presence flags
features.standardisation: every input z-scored per dim on train+val rows
features.model: Dropout(in_drop) - Linear(d, 256) - GELU - Dropout(0.3) - Linear(256, 40); AdamW wd 0.1, batch 512, cosine over 80 epochs, early stop on val NLL (patience 8), CPU. Per feature set the same grid lr x in_drop = {1e-4,1e-3} x {0,0.5} is run; the model with the lowest val MAE (expectation decoder) is reported (results), the lowest-val-NLL one is kept in results_nll_selected. val = held-out songs. (Run 1 with a single lr 1e-3 / wd 1e-2 setting over-fitted within one epoch on every audio set; run 2 with a wd axis showed wd has no effect.)
features.cv: 5 by-song folds from one seeded shuffle (fold 0 = the reported split); folds 1-4 reuse each set's fold-0 configuration; PCA / standardisation statistics stay those of fold 0 (unsupervised, mild leakage into folds 1-4)
features.decoders: argmax class; expectation sum_k p_k k. Errors against the integer target (0-39 ms); mae_vs_exact_ms uses the sub-ms onset position

decision.rule: remove the mel branch if MAE_A_all - MAE_B <= 1 ms and MAE_A_all - MAE_C <= 1 ms (test split, expectation decoder, models selected on val MAE)

text: 条件 1（预注册判据，固定切分）：满足（A_all−B +0.56，A_all−C +0.66 ms）。
条件 2（同判据，5 折均值）：不满足（+1.34 ± 0.67，+1.60 ± 0.83 ms）；预注册的 A_all（两级 PCA 到 2048 维）是最差的 token 表示（5 折 9.25 ms，对比随机投影 A_all_rp 7.30、A_all_rpd 7.18 ms），它在固定切分上的“满足”是弱对弱的巧合。
条件 3（最优 token 表示 A_all_rpd 对最优学习型 mel 表示 B_flux 与对 token+mel 的 C_flux，5 折均值）：满足（-0.42 ± 0.28，-0.02 ± 0.03 ms）：学习型读出下 token 不劣于 mel，且 mel 叠加到 token 上没有增益。
条件 4（A_all_rpd 对非学习的 mel 谱通量启发式 B_heur，mania，固定切分）：不满足（+1.52 ms；5 折 -1.22 ± 2.14 ms，折间不稳定）：mel 里仍有一部分相位信息是零参数启发式能读出、而 38 首歌训练的 token 探针在该切分上读不出的；phira 上启发式无信息（10.38 ms ≈ 机会水平）。
summary.verdict: 按预注册判据：删 mel 支路。稳健性支持“token 不劣于学习型 mel 读出、mel 无叠加增益”，但未能证明 token 已含 mel 的全部相位信息（条件 4 不满足）。建议：删 mel 支路，但保留 §5 实验 4 的 mel × 间隔核 2×2 对照作为验证；所有音频探针都远不及节律先验（E_only）。
